copy_to_tensor_model_parallel_region: copy a tensor into the tensor model parallel region for distributed training across GPUs
reduce_from_tensor_model_parallel_region: all-reduce a tensor from the tensor model parallel region across the model parallel group
scatter_to_tensor_model_parallel_region: scatter a tensor along its last dimension across the tensor model parallel region
gather_from_tensor_model_parallel_region: gather and concatenate tensors from the tensor model parallel region along the last dimension
scatter_to_sequence_parallel_region: scatter a tensor along its first dimension across the sequence parallel region for distributed training
